bayts.text: O You through Whom generosity heads toward my quarters, bless him whose name is Mukarram (the Honoured),
And grant him peace with the community, and make Your good pleasure lasting for me together with a community,
without enemy and without obscurity, O Everlasting Who has been for me what I hoped.
O You through Whom firm establishment yields to me, bless him whose name is Makīn (the Firmly Established),
And grant him peace with the Family and his Companions, in the present and then in what will be fulfilled.
O You through Whom temptations have not headed toward me, bless him whose name is Matīn (the Firm),
the Family and the Companions, with peace and blessings, and lead (people) to my teaching.
O Most Generous, Whose being for me becomes manifest, bless him whose name is Mubīn (the Clarifier),
the Family and the Companions of integrity, with peace, and spare me treachery.
O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), with Whom deeds grow pure, bless him whose name is Muʾammal (the Hoped-for),
the Family and the Companions of scrupulousness, with peace, and make my prosperity everlasting.
O You toward Whom go need and arrival, bless him whose name is Waṣūl (the Uniter),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and by my works dispel the darknesses.
O You through Whom we have strength and power, bless him whose name is Dhū Quwwa (Possessor of strength),
And grant him peace together with the Family and the Companions, and gather the (spiritual) stations in my works.
O Everlasting Who leads mercy to me, bless with peace the possessor of sanctity,
the Family and the Companions of bounty, and illumine my breast without veil.
O best of hosts, Whose lodging I behold, bless the Chosen One, possessor of high standing,
the Family and the Companions, and grant peace, just as by his mission You dispelled the darknesses.
O best Provider and best of those obeyed, bless the possessor of might, the possessor of excellence, the obeyed,
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and through me illumine the heart of whoever learns.
O You Who honour every obedient believer, bless with peace an obedient guide,
his Family and his Companions, brothers; and drive every aggressor toward others than me.
Bless the Footing of truth (Qurʾān 10:2), the Mercy, the Glad Tidings, and grant peace, O Perpetuator of grace,
the Family and the Companions, and make my sojourn (here) the most excellent success and the best abiding.
Bless the Succour, the Beneficent Rain and the Relief, and grant peace, O You Who erased (sins) without probing,
the Family and the Companions of benefits, and be for me, O best Giver, Benefactor.
Bless the Gift of God, the Firmest Handhold, the Path of Allah,
the Grace of Allah, and grant peace for ever, with the Family and the Companions; and make my striving praiseworthy.
And guard all the Muslims, O Preserver, and accept from me the thought together with the word.
Convey Your two greetings to Your steadfast servant, Muḥammad, who is the straight path.
and the Family and the Companions; and make the protection of my whole being everlasting, O You Who spared me a blow.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him whom You named Dhikr Allāh (Remembrance of Allah),
the Family and the Companions, people of gratitude, O You Who spared me the cunning of every schemer.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him whom You named Sayf Allāh (Sword of Allah),
the Family, the Companions and every sound one, O You Who through Yourself spared me every oppressor.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, upon him whom You named Ḥizb Allāh (Party of Allah),
the Family and the Companions endowed with (divine) good pleasure, O Enricher Who has freed from aggression.
O best of those who converse intimately and of those who watch, bless a luminous, piercing Star (Qurʾān 86:3),
his Family and his Companions, with peace; and for the Gardens grant me the best of speech.
For Your noble Face grant me, for the Gardens, Your remembrance through the Qurʾān, which has made the heart wholesome.
And bless him who attained election, the Muṣṭafā, the Muntaqā and the Mujtabā (the Chosen, the Select, the Elect),
and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and with my generosity put the cloud to shame.
And through me gladden, every year and every season, whoever through me seeks Him Who is exalted above slumber (Qurʾān 2:255).
And by my writing, Lord, nurture every reader who reads for the Face of the Lord.
And by my speech and by the stirring (it brings), guide the disciple who seeks illumination.
O You Who lead to me what I choose, bless him whose name is al-Mukhtār (the Chosen),
and grant him peace with his Family and his Companions; and make my script part of his luminous road.
O You through Whom what is sublime comes to me, bless a Light who is the Ummiyy (the unlettered Prophet),
the Family and the Companions true to their covenants, with peace; and make my contemplation lasting.
O You through Whom rewards yield to me, bless him whose name is Ajīr (the Servant),
with Your peace, together with his Family and his Companions, O You Who have heard my supplication.
O You to Whom belong glorification and magnification, bless him whose name is Jabbār (the Mighty),
with peace, together with all the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
The blessing of the Lord of the mighty Throne, the Most Generous, upon Abū l-Qāsim, the bountiful,
upon his Family and his Companions, with peace, just as through him (Allah) erased error and darkness.
The blessing of Him Who granted me understanding, upon the father of the lord Ibrāhīm,
with His peace, together with his noble Family and his Companions, just as through them I attained my aim.
The blessing of Him Who bestows on me what is good, upon the father of aṭ-Ṭayyib, pride of the noble,
with His peace, together with his noble Family and his Companions, just as he rose without cease.
